+class CaseInsensitiveHeaders(dict):
+    def __setitem__(self, key, value):
+        super().__setitem__(key.lower(), value)
+
+    def __getitem__(self, key):
+        return super().__getitem__(key.lower())
+
+    def get(self, key, default=None):
+        return super().get(key.lower(), default)
+
+
+class _PycurlResponse:
+    def __init__(self, status_code: int, content: bytes, headers: CaseInsensitiveHeaders):
+        self.status_code = status_code
+        self.content = content
+        self.headers = headers
+        self.text = self._decode_text()
+
+    def _decode_text(self) -> str:
+        content_type = self.headers.get('content-type', '') or ''
+        charset = 'utf-8'
+        if 'charset=' in content_type:
+            charset = content_type.split('charset=', 1)[1].split(';', 1)[0].strip() or 'utf-8'
+        return self.content.decode(charset, errors='replace')
+
+    def raise_for_status(self) -> None:
+        if self.status_code >= 400:
+            raise RuntimeError(f'HTTP error {self.status_code}')
+
+
+class _PycurlSession:
+    def get(self, url, verify=True, proxies=None):
+        return self._request('GET', url, verify=verify, proxies=proxies)
+
+    def post(self, url, data=None, headers=None, verify=True, proxies=None):
+        return self._request('POST', url, data=data, headers=headers, verify=verify, proxies=proxies)
+
+    def _request(self, method, url, data=None, headers=None, verify=True, proxies=None):
+        body = io.BytesIO()
+        response_headers = CaseInsensitiveHeaders()
+
+        def header_callback(header_line: bytes) -> int:
+            nonlocal response_headers
+
+            line = header_line.decode('iso-8859-1').strip()
+            if line.startswith('HTTP/'):
+                response_headers = CaseInsensitiveHeaders()
+            elif ':' in line:
+                key, value = line.split(':', 1)
+                response_headers[key] = value.strip()
+            return len(header_line)
+
+        curl = pycurl.Curl()
+        try:
+            curl.setopt(pycurl.URL, url)
+            curl.setopt(pycurl.FOLLOWLOCATION, 1)
+            curl.setopt(pycurl.NOSIGNAL, 1)
+            curl.setopt(pycurl.WRITEFUNCTION, body.write)
+            curl.setopt(pycurl.HEADERFUNCTION, header_callback)
+
+            if not verify:
+                curl.setopt(pycurl.SSL_VERIFYPEER, 0)
+                curl.setopt(pycurl.SSL_VERIFYHOST, 0)
+
+            if proxies:
+                self._set_proxy(curl, url, proxies)
+
+            if method == 'POST':
+                payload = bytes(data or b'')
+                curl.setopt(pycurl.POST, 1)
+                curl.setopt(pycurl.POSTFIELDS, payload)
+                curl.setopt(pycurl.POSTFIELDSIZE, len(payload))
+                if headers:
+                    curl.setopt(pycurl.HTTPHEADER, [f'{key}: {value}' for key, value in headers.items()])
+            else:
+                curl.setopt(pycurl.HTTPGET, 1)
+
+            curl.perform()
+            status_code = curl.getinfo(pycurl.RESPONSE_CODE)
+        finally:
+            curl.close()
+
+        return _PycurlResponse(status_code, body.getvalue(), response_headers)
+
+    def _set_proxy(self, curl, url, proxies):
+        proxy = proxies.get('https') if url.startswith('https://') else proxies.get('http')
+        if not proxy:
+            return
+
+        parsed = urlsplit(proxy if '://' in proxy else f'//{proxy}')
+        proxy_host = parsed.hostname or proxy
+        if parsed.port:
+            proxy_host = f'{proxy_host}:{parsed.port}'
+
+        curl.setopt(pycurl.PROXY, proxy_host)
+
+        if parsed.username or parsed.password:
+            username = parsed.username or ''
+            password = parsed.password or ''
+            curl.setopt(pycurl.PROXYUSERPWD, f'{username}:{password}')
+
+        scheme = (parsed.scheme or 'http').lower()
+        if scheme in {'http', 'https'}:
+            proxy_type = pycurl.PROXYTYPE_HTTP
+        elif scheme == 'socks4':
+            proxy_type = pycurl.PROXYTYPE_SOCKS4
+        elif scheme == 'socks4a':
+            proxy_type = getattr(pycurl, 'PROXYTYPE_SOCKS4A', pycurl.PROXYTYPE_SOCKS4)
+        elif scheme == 'socks5h':
+            proxy_type = getattr(pycurl, 'PROXYTYPE_SOCKS5_HOSTNAME', pycurl.PROXYTYPE_SOCKS5)
+        elif scheme == 'socks5':
+            proxy_type = pycurl.PROXYTYPE_SOCKS5
+        else:
+            proxy_type = pycurl.PROXYTYPE_HTTP
+
+        curl.setopt(pycurl.PROXYTYPE, proxy_type)
+
+
